paras: The wing-snapping cisticola (Cisticola ayresii), also known as Ayres' cisticola,  is a species of bird in the family Cisticolidae. Its scientific name honours South African ornithologist Thomas Ayres.
It is found throughout central and southern Africa.  Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical dry lowland grassland and subtropical or tropical high-altitude grassland.
